$description: Helix DS tokens — 3 layers: primitive (raw scale) → semantic (role aliases) → component (component-specific).

inverse.$description: Dark, theme-invariant surface fill — pairs with text.inverse/icon.inverse. Stays dark in both light and dark mode (e.g. Tooltip's content background), unlike surface/surface-dark which flip.

primary.$description: Mid-tone primary fill for static brand accents. Charts use semantic.color.chart.series-* instead.

primary-light.$description: Lighter primary fill for decorative, non-interactive accents. Charts use semantic.color.chart.series-* instead.

primary-interactive-light-default.$description: Tinted primary background — subtle emphasis, default state

primary-interactive-light-hover.$description: Tinted primary background — subtle emphasis, hover state

danger-interactive-light-default.$description: Tinted danger background — subtle emphasis, default state

danger-interactive-light-hover.$description: Tinted danger background — subtle emphasis, hover state

success-light.$description: Tinted success background — badges, inline banners

warning-light.$description: Tinted warning background — badges, inline banners

info-light.$description: Tinted info background — badges, inline banners

secondary-interactive-dark-default.$description: Strong neutral fill for a control that must stand out from the page on its own (3:1) — e.g. an unchecked Switch track, rest state

secondary-interactive-dark-hover.$description: Strong neutral fill, hover state (unchecked Switch track on hover)

neutral.$description: Primary body text — WCAG AAA on white

neutral-light.$description: Supporting text — WCAG AA on white

disabled.$description: Disabled state text — not WCAG compliant by design

inverse.$description: White icon color — on brand/danger fills

neutral-dark.$description: Stronger border — emphasis without full contrast

danger.$description: Official danger border — hover state, and the invalid/error border for form fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio). The base/default tone for this role; danger-light is the decorative exception, not this.

danger-light.$description: Lightened danger border — used only for decorative/low-emphasis borders (Badge), not real interactive borders. An exception to the base danger tone, used less often.

success.$description: Official success border — hover state and other real interactive borders. The base/default tone for this role.

success-light.$description: Lightened success border — used only for decorative/low-emphasis borders (Badge), not real interactive borders.

info.$description: Official info border — hover state and other real interactive borders. The base/default tone for this role.

info-light.$description: Lightened info border — used only for decorative/low-emphasis borders (Badge), not real interactive borders.

warning.$description: Official warning border — hover state and other real interactive borders. The base/default tone for this role.

warning-light.$description: Lightened warning border — used only for decorative/low-emphasis borders (Badge), not real interactive borders.

series-1.$description: First data series in a chart — the primary blue, same as the primary Button. Every next series is a blue far from the one before it, never a near tone — always >=3:1 on the page. Not a status color.

series-2.$description: Second data series in a chart — the darkest blue, the furthest from the primary that still meets 3:1 on white. Not a status color.

series-3.$description: Third data series in a chart — the lightest blue that meets 3:1 on white, opposite the dark second series. Not a status color.

series-4.$description: Fourth data series in a chart — dark blue. Not a status color.

series-5.$description: Fifth data series in a chart — dark blue. Not a status color.

series-6.$description: Sixth data series in a chart — categorical palette, in series order. Neutral, so it reads as a reference series when last. Not a status color.

focus.$description: Focus ring shadow — keyboard focus indicator

base.$description: Default transition duration — most UI animations

draw.$description: Drawing a shape into view — a chart line or illustration path sweeping in

stagger.$description: Delay between items entering one after another — chart points and bars, illustration parts

in.$description: Accelerating — elements exiting or being dismissed

gentle.$description: Smooth decelerate-with-settle — expand/collapse, stacking, sliding-panel and overlay transitions (Accordion, Toast, Dialog, SidePanel).

enter.$description: Blur-to-focus arrival — content fades in from a slight blur instead of a hard cut. Shared by Accordion, SidePanel, and Toast, all independently tuned to the same 2px.

m.$description: Default hover lift — a single emphasized element

l.$description: Prominent lift — drag/reorder, elevated hover states

s.$description: Subtle hover scale — paired with lift.s or used alone

m.$description: Default hover scale — a single emphasized element

3xs.$description: Hairline gap between an icon and the text it belongs to, so both read as one unit (e.g. a trend arrow and its delta).

2xs.$description: Very tight gap between closely related inline elements.

s.$description: Small spacing step for compact gaps.

m.$description: Default spacing step for general gaps.

l.$description: Large spacing step for roomy gaps.

xl.$description: Extra-large spacing step for wide gaps.

xs.$description: Smallest t-shirt size for dense buttons or compact actions.

s.$description: Small t-shirt size for compact buttons and field inputs.

m.$description: Default t-shirt size for shared buttons and fields.

l.$description: Large t-shirt size for roomier buttons and fields.

xl.$description: Largest t-shirt size for dense button layouts.

2xl.$description: Extra-large t-shirt size, past the standard control scale.

3xs.$description: Extra-extra-small t-shirt size, below the standard control scale's xs rung.

thin.$description: Base 1px line — resting borders: buttons and all form fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio), Card.

thick.$description: Heavier 2px line — a focused/active form field's border, and AvatarGroup's separator ring between overlapping avatars.

3xl.$description: Maximum practical rounding before full pill

full.$description: Fully rounded — pills, avatars, circular controls

l.$description: 87.5% of primitive.fontSize.l (18px) — mobile override below primitive.breakpoint.tablet. Only l-6xl get a mobile override — the Responsive threshold is primitive.fontSize >= 18px; xs/s/m stay constant across breakpoints.

s.$description: Paired with fontSize.s — same ratio as Body text styles

m.$description: Paired with fontSize.m — same ratio as Body text styles

l.$description: Paired with fontSize.l — relaxed ratio for larger body text

xl.$description: Paired with fontSize.xl — snug ratio for small headings

2xl.$description: Paired with fontSize.2xl — snug ratio for medium headings

3xl.$description: Paired with fontSize.3xl — tight ratio for large headings

4xl.$description: Paired with fontSize.4xl — tight ratio for display text

5xl.$description: Paired with fontSize.5xl — tight ratio for large display text

6xl.$description: Same ratio at every breakpoint — lineHeight is unitless, already scales with fontSize

display-6xl-bold.$description: Display / 6xl / Bold — largest display text, page heroes.

heading-3xl-bold.$description: Heading / 3xl / Bold — large heading, bold weight (e.g. a stat/metric card's headline value).

heading-2xl-bold.$description: Heading / 2xl / Bold — medium heading, bold weight (e.g. PageHeader's top-level title).

heading-xl-bold.$description: Heading / xl / Bold — small heading, bold weight (e.g. PageHeader's secondary title level).

heading-l-bold.$description: Heading / l / Bold — compact card/panel header, between xl and m in the heading scale (e.g. Card's own header).

heading-m-bold.$description: Heading / m / Bold — compact section/block title, e.g. one labeled group of fields within a longer form.

body-l-medium.$description: Body / l / Medium — large body text, medium weight.

body-l-regular.$description: Body / l / Regular — large body text.

body-m-semibold.$description: Body / m / Semibold — default body text, semibold weight (e.g. Button/Avatar's l size label).

body-m-medium.$description: Body / m / Medium — default body text, medium weight.

body-m-regular.$description: Body / m / Regular — default body text.

body-s-medium.$description: Body / s / Medium — small body text, medium weight.

body-s-regular.$description: Body / s / Regular — small body text.

label-uppercase.$description: Label / Uppercase — all-caps field/section labels (apply text-transform + letter-spacing at the call site; not part of this token).

x-l.$description: Label box side padding at size l — 16px button padding + 4px here = 20px per side, a step the spacing scale doesn't have on its own (ADR-004).

m.$description: 12px, same as s — 13px visual from the border to the label, matching the ~12px visual from a dismiss X to the right border.

s.$description: 4px between chip parts. Icon-to-label reads 6px: each icon adds 2px (spacing-3xs) on its label side — two scale tokens instead of an off-scale 6px literal.

overlay-opacity.$description: Backdrop opacity applied to overlay via color-mix() — see ADR-010's Backdrop note.
